purpose: Independent chronological scale-up of the frozen Slice 0B discovery pipeline.

pipeline_freeze.calibration_verdict: SLICE 0 DISCOVERY PIPELINE READY FOR CHRONOLOGICAL SCALE-UP

selection_methodology.rationale: Slice 0 is diagnostic and noncontiguous (selected dates span 2025-05-22..2026-09-08), so a literal block after its maximum date cannot satisfy the established 150-200 scale-up target before denominator end. Slice 1 therefore uses the earliest deterministic chronological date-complete block of frozen denominator episodes that does not overlap Slice 0.
selection_methodology.start_rule: Start at earliest frozen Zaporizhzhia denominator alert date, without conditioning on historical positives or source availability.
selection_methodology.stop_rule: Add complete chronological Kyiv alert-start dates until unique episode count first reaches at least 170 without exceeding 200.
